name: shdr-04
title: SHDR-04
description: A hollow shell of light, faceted by a voxel lattice and approached but never reached: the march sphere-traces a shell at a tenth of the remaining distance per step, so it closes on the surface asymptotically from outside and the accumulated one-over-step is dominated by the last few samples. All six turbulence octaves quantize on the SAME fixed lattice pitch — only the phase multiplier changes — so the displacement is piecewise constant and the shell facets at one crisp scale rather than fractally. Position paints the colour, washing toward a white floor with depth.
